meta.name: update-nanoclaw
meta.description: Efficiently bring upstream NanoClaw updates into a customized install, with preview, selective cherry-pick, and low token usage.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预览上游更新,挑选合入定制安装
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果维护着定制版NanoClaw,想便捷同步官方更新
copy.tagline_en: Preview upstream updates and cherry-pick them into your customized install
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a customized NanoClaw and want to sync official updates

howto.what: 运行后，Claude 会检查工作区是否干净，创建带时间戳的备份，预览上游 NanoClaw 改动，让你选全量合并、选择性挑提交或放弃；随后解决冲突、运行构建与测试，并列出破坏性变更及迁移提示。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中输入 `/update-nanoclaw` 命令时触发，用于把上游 NanoClaw 更新合并进你定制过的安装。

say.text: 运行 /update-nanoclaw，合并全部上游更新。
say.note: 走默认的 merge 路径。
对应 Abort 选项，只看变更。

say.text: 运行 /update-nanoclaw，挑部分提交来更新。
say.note: 走 cherry-pick 选择性更新。

howto.what_en: Claude checks git tree, creates timestamped backup, previews upstream changes, lets you pick full merge, cherry-pick, or abort, resolves conflicts, runs build/tests, and flags breaking changes with migration hints.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type /update-nanoclaw in Claude Code, for customized NanoClaw installs that need upstream updates.

say_en.text: Run /update-nanoclaw to merge all upstream updates.

say_en.note: Corresponds to Abort, just view changes.
